# t8.1 — NASA-like design system and visual acceptance for T003

## Result

Updated T003 and plan item 2.1 in the approved implementation plan. The implementation handoff now explicitly requires a centralized Tailwind design system with reusable accessible custom components and visual verification at desktop and mobile sizes. The existing T003 source anchors, Plan 2.1 association, and REQ traceability remain unchanged.

## T003 acceptance added

- Implement one coherent, professional NASA-like visual language using centralized Tailwind tokens and reusable accessible custom components; do not imply NASA affiliation or use its logo.
- Apply the approved restrained deep-space navy/charcoal and lunar-neutral surfaces, crisp high-contrast type, limited cyan/blue action accent, and semantic status treatments consistently to menu/tutorial/campus and route shells.
- Capture and visually review the fresh `/` render at desktop and mobile viewports. Conspicuous lunar ground must be visible beneath/behind the initial menu; a black-void-only start fails.
- Verify contrast at 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text and relevant controls/graphics, visible keyboard focus, and status meaning that is not conveyed by color alone in both Italian and English.
- Preserve the existing first-person, semantic-panel, mobile/touch, no-iframe, recovery, and legacy source-reference acceptance.

## Traceability

- T003 remains `[Plan:2.1]` and retains its `Go-No-Go.html` source anchor.
- Plan item 2.1 remains mapped to REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-005, REQ-017, REQ-021, REQ-022, and REQ-023; no checkpoint mapping changes were needed.
- The t6 browser strategy already requires desktop/mobile screenshots of the first visit and human visual review; these screenshots provide downstream visual evidence for the new acceptance.
